sister_company_policy.note: Environmental-vertical extension. The vertical's core positioning is INDEPENDENCE: the client tests and verifies, they do not remediate, and their credibility comes from having no financial stake in the cleanup. Some environmental clients nevertheless operate alongside a disclosed sister company (typically a remediation or restoration firm: we find and document the problem, the sister company performs the cleanup). This policy governs EXTERNAL cross-links to that sister company; it does not add internal-link kinds above. Cross-vertical referrals TO restoration/remediation companies are the ONLY context in which restoration language may appear in this vertical's content.
sister_company_policy.brand_field: brand.sister_company — OPTIONAL object in plan-input.json's brand block: {"name": "...", "url": "https://...", "relationship": "..."} (relationship is a short human phrase, e.g. "sister company" or "our remediation partner").
when_present: Content MAY reference the sister company on remediation-adjacent topics only: what happens after a failed test, mold remediation scoping, asbestos/lead abatement next steps, sewage cleanup after a contamination finding, water damage drying after a post-flood assessment. Example framing: "if the results call for remediation, our sister company {name} can perform the work."

Maximum 1-2 contextual cross-links to sister_company.url per page, placed inline where the remediation handoff is genuinely relevant. NEVER sitewide: no header, footer, nav, sidebar, or boilerplate-block placement.
The relationship must be disclosed in the surrounding sentence using the provided relationship phrase. Never present the sister company as an unaffiliated third-party recommendation.

INDEPENDENCE DISCLOSURE (this vertical's extra rule): any page that references the sister company must also state, in plain language, how independence is preserved — e.g. that the client is never required to use the sister company, that clearance/verification testing after the sister company's work is performed to the same standard, or that the report is contractor-neutral and usable with any qualified remediator. Never let a sister-company mention quietly undo the no-conflict-of-interest positioning.
Never claim capabilities FOR the sister company beyond a generic remediation/abatement/cleanup handoff. Its certifications, licenses, and response times are its own site's claims, not ours.
when_absent: If brand.sister_company is not present in the client's plan-input.json brand block, the client has no disclosed sister company. NEVER invent, imply, or placeholder one.

Remediation-adjacent topics then end at the testing scope (find it, measure it, document it, verify the fix) plus neutral advice such as hiring a qualified, unaffiliated remediation contractor and returning for independent clearance testing, with no link and no name. This absence is itself a selling point: lean into the pure-independence framing.
